q: Select the continent of the Saint Lawrence.
e: The Saint Lawrence is associated with Canada and United States and reaches the Gulf of Saint Lawrence.

q: Select the continent of the Orinoco.
e: The Orinoco is associated with Venezuela and Colombia and reaches the Atlantic Ocean.

q: Select the continent of the Magdalena.
e: The Magdalena is associated with Colombia and reaches the Caribbean Sea.

q: Select the continent of the Uruguay.
e: The Uruguay is associated with Brazil, Uruguay and Argentina and reaches the Río de la Plata.

q: Select the continent of the Tocantins.
e: The Tocantins is associated with Brazil and reaches the Atlantic Ocean.

q: Select the continent of the São Francisco.
e: The São Francisco is associated with Brazil and reaches the Atlantic Ocean.

q: Select the continent of the Darling.
e: The Darling is associated with Australia and reaches the Murray River.

q: Select the continent of the Fly.
e: The Fly is associated with Papua New Guinea and reaches the Gulf of Papua.

q: Select the continent of the Sepik.
e: The Sepik is associated with Papua New Guinea and reaches the Bismarck Sea.

q: Select the continent of the Waikato.
e: The Waikato is associated with New Zealand and reaches the Tasman Sea.

q: Select the continent of the Jhelum.
e: The Jhelum is associated with India and Pakistan and reaches the Chenab River.

q: Select the continent of the Chenab.
e: The Chenab is associated with India and Pakistan and joins the Sutlej to form the Panjnad River.

q: Select the continent of the Ravi.
e: The Ravi is associated with India and Pakistan and reaches the Chenab River.

q: Select the continent of the Sutlej.
e: The Sutlej is associated with China, India and Pakistan and joins the Chenab to form the Panjnad River.

q: Select the continent of the Kabul River.
e: The Kabul River is associated with Afghanistan and Pakistan and reaches the Indus River.
